actions.sql:
SELECT
  c.c_w_id, c.c_d_id, c.c_id,
  SUM(ol.ol_amount) AS total_spent
FROM customer c
JOIN oorder o
  ON o.o_w_id = c.c_w_id AND o.o_d_id = c.c_d_id AND o.o_c_id = c.c_id
JOIN order_line ol
  ON ol.ol_w_id = o.o_w_id AND ol.ol_d_id = o.o_d_id AND ol.ol_o_id = o.o_id
JOIN stock s
  ON s.s_w_id = ol.ol_supply_w_id AND s.s_i_id = ol.ol_i_id
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_id = ol.ol_i_id
WHERE c.c_last LIKE '%BAR%'
  AND i.i_name LIKE '%PR%'
GROUP BY c.c_w_id, c.c_d_id, c.c_id
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 200;

success_criteria: At least 1 slow query recorded during injection window
Either Sort_merge_passes or Rows_examined increases notably
p95 latency ratio during injection >= 1.5 vs baseline
risk_assessment: Read-heavy multi-table join may increase CPU and disk IO
Potential temporary table and filesort usage may elevate IO wait
Low risk of lock contention since query is SELECT-only
